text: Indoor lab bench scene against a pale grey wall. Centre: a raised white platform/stage carrying a dark grey (black) tube holder or rack block, standing upright. Seated in it is a conical tube with an orange screw cap in place; the tube body shows a red/pink liquid level near the top, with the lower portion appearing dark. Behind the tube is a black clamp or gripper bar on a horizontal rail, and a small white rectangular device/box to its right. A black-and-white square fiducial marker is mounted on the platform's front face. Left foreground: a white weighing balance with a blue display and keypad, plus a cable running to it. Right: a vertical white aluminium extrusion column with bolts, and blue equipment behind.
